title: Pairwise XOR of decoded lists
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, take the two lists obtained by decoding it as a pair, and return their positionwise exclusive OR, stopping when either list ends.
caveat: The definitions of the pair-decoding operation are not included, so its precise convention is unspecified.
